reason: User requested in-simulator strain acquisition, training and separate virtual motion-capture truth. Supersedes the hardware-sessions task; applies before training or held-out scoring. A five-frame calibration-seed pilot verified RGB-D decoding only.

sensors.strain: Four virtual 60 mm surface gauge lengths at material azimuths 0,90,180,270 degrees and central arc stations 0.11..0.17 m; 25 mm visual radius. Deformed material paths from simulated segment frames, normalized against straight free lengths, sampled at 50 Hz with 45 ms transducer lag, gains, session bias/noise, quantization and neutral tare; synthetic equivalent surface strain, not measured material stress.
sensors.camera: Rendered 480x360 wrist RGB-D, known surveyed visual-only boards, metric marker localization, reported PX4 base attitude at capture time, calibrated rigid mount and camera/tool extrinsics. 5 Hz, delivered one decision tick later. No simulation camera pose supplied to detector.
sensors.mocap: Noiseless independent noncoplanar virtual marker clusters fixed to mount and tool, rigid registration and relative distal tangent for theta/phi/2D bending. Centreline and TCP from full simulated link geometry are scoring channels. Mocap is accessible only to offline label creation and scoring.

bench.curve: piecewise quintic in bending-vector space with four directions/amplitudes per session; train azimuth steps 45 deg; separate unseen azimuths, independent sensor seeds and different timings for validation/test
bench.predictor: training-only standardization, 4 tare-adjusted channels and opposing differences, degree-2 polynomial ridge, lambda 0.01; target is relative marker bending vector, convert to theta/phi; validation reports frozen sensor-only residuals; no parameter selection on held-out flights
